messages.content: Fixed KeyError in cell 8 by changing DataFrame indexing from positional (bracket notation) to .iloc accessor. The original code attempted to use KFold indices like X_train[train_idx], which treats the indices as column labels in pandas. Changed to X_train.iloc[train_idx] and y_train.iloc[train_idx] to properly select rows, and renamed the training fold variables to avoid overwriting the original X_train and y_train within the loop.
